question: Name one feature added in the latest Autodesk Fusion update.
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 major update, with the latest minor update being v.2706.1.17 (October 28, 2026) [1].

One feature added is Auto Timeline, which uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to convert imported, non-native geometry into an editable parametric Fusion design [4]. It currently reconstructs extrudes, revolves, chamfers, fillets, holes and basic sweeps, and it is built for quick model adjustments rather than full rebuilds [4].

Other additions include a no-code, node-based System Modeler [4] and Auto-update Zone and Auto-update Sheet options in the Revision History dialog for Drawings [1]. Both sources describe this same October 2026 release, so no older release is involved.

keyPoints.text: The October 2026 Fusion major update adds Auto Timeline, which uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to turn imported non-native geometry into an editable parametric design.
The October 2026 update adds Integrated Task Management, letting teams plan, assign and track work with Kanban or list views inside Fusion.
The October 2026 update adds Revision History tables in Drawings that can auto-update Zone and Sheet information.
The latest minor update is v.2706.1.17 dated October 28, 2026, which contains stability fixes rather than new features.
